% Shared Tikz Preamble for Diagram Atomization Pipeline
% Load this in every tikz generated by Phase 5 subagents.
% Do NOT redefine these — use exactly this preamble.

\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}

% Core libraries
\usetikzlibrary{
    arrows.meta,       % arrow styles
    positioning,       % relative placement
    cd,                % commutative diagrams (tikz-cd)
    calc,              % coordinate calculations
    shapes.geometric,  % ellipses, polygons, etc.
    shapes.misc,       % rounded rectangles, etc.
    decorations.markings,  % arrow on paths
    backgrounds,       % background layer
    fit,               % fitting nodes around others
    patterns,          % fill patterns
    patterns.meta,     % advanced patterns (Lines, etc.)
}

% Standard arrow tip
\tikzset{>=Stealth}

% Commutative diagram style
\tikzcdset{
    arrows={>=Stealth},
    row sep/normal=3em,
    column sep/normal=4em,
}

% Common node styles
\tikzset{
    mathnode/.style={rectangle, draw=none, fill=none, inner sep=2pt},
    labelnode/.style={rectangle, draw=none, fill=none, font=\small, inner sep=1pt},
}

\begin{document}
% Dual cones $\sigma_i^\vee$ in $M_{\mathbb{R}}$ for the fan of $\mathbb{P}^2$.
% Three lines through the origin (horizontal, vertical, diagonal $y=-x$) divide
% the plane into six sectors. Three are shaded with diagonal dashed hatching
% and labeled $\sigma_0^\vee$, $\sigma_1^\vee$, $\sigma_2^\vee$; three are
% unshaded gaps.

\begin{tikzpicture}[>=Stealth, scale=2.5]

% --- Dimensions ---
\def\R{2.6}           % radius for shaded sector arcs
\def\Raxis{2.8}       % axis line half-length

% --- Custom pattern: diagonal dashed hatching ---
\pgfdeclarepatternformonly{dashed hatch}{\pgfqpoint{-1pt}{-1pt}}{\pgfqpoint{4pt}{4pt}}{\pgfqpoint{4pt}{4pt}}%
{
  \pgfsetdash{{1.2pt}{1.2pt}}{0pt}%
  \pgfsetlinewidth{0.35pt}%
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfqpoint{0pt}{0pt}}%
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{4pt}{4pt}}%
  \pgfusepath{stroke}%
}

\tikzset{
    dashed-hatch/.style={
        pattern=dashed hatch,
        pattern color=black!55
    }
}

% === SHADED SECTORS (dual cones) ===

% σ₀^∨: First quadrant — between East (0°) and North (90°)
\fill[dashed-hatch] (0,0) -- (\R,0) arc[start angle=0, end angle=90, radius=\R] -- cycle;

% σ₁^∨: Upper-left sector — between Northwest (135°) and West (180°)
% (going counterclockwise from 135° to 180°)
\fill[dashed-hatch] (0,0) -- ({cos(135)*\R},{sin(135)*\R}) arc[start angle=135, end angle=180, radius=\R] -- cycle;

% σ₂^∨: Lower-right sector — between South (270°) and Southeast (315°)
% (going counterclockwise from 270° to 315°)
\fill[dashed-hatch] (0,0) -- ({cos(270)*\R},{sin(270)*\R}) arc[start angle=270, end angle=315, radius=\R] -- cycle;

% === AXIS LINES (three lines through origin, each with two arrowheads) ===

% Horizontal axis (x-axis) — East-West line
\draw[->,thick] (-\Raxis,0) -- (\Raxis,0);
\draw[->,thick] (\Raxis,0) -- (-\Raxis,0);

% Vertical axis (y-axis) — North-South line
\draw[->,thick] (0,-\Raxis) -- (0,\Raxis);
\draw[->,thick] (0,\Raxis) -- (0,-\Raxis);

% Diagonal axis (y = -x) — Northwest-Southeast line
% Direction vector (-1,1) = Northwest; direction vector (1,-1) = Southeast
\draw[->,thick] ({-\Raxis/sqrt(2)},{\Raxis/sqrt(2)}) -- ({\Raxis/sqrt(2)},{-\Raxis/sqrt(2)});
\draw[->,thick] ({\Raxis/sqrt(2)},{-\Raxis/sqrt(2)}) -- ({-\Raxis/sqrt(2)},{\Raxis/sqrt(2)});

% === LABELS ===

% σ₀^∨: placed inside the first quadrant
\node[scale=1.1] at (1.0,0.6) {$\sigma_0^\vee$};

% σ₁^∨: placed inside the upper-left sector
\node[scale=1.1] at (-1.2,0.7) {$\sigma_1^\vee$};

% σ₂^∨: placed inside the lower-right sector
\node[scale=1.1] at (1.2,-0.7) {$\sigma_2^\vee$};

\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
